Usage: cider-server [options]
       cider-server calibrate [calibrate-options]

Subcommands:
  calibrate                        Fit per-question calibration parameters from a labeled JSONL dataset
                                   and write a versioned JSON calibration profile (run 'cider-server calibrate --help')

Server options:
  --port N                         HTTP port to listen on over 127.0.0.1 (default: 8080)
  --socket PATH                    Listen on a user-only Unix domain socket (Linux/macOS, 0600) or
                                   current-user Windows named pipe instead of TCP loopback
  --model NAME                     Served model identifier (default: jev-1.13.0)
  --backend KIND                   Backend: ollama | llamacpp | managed | systemone | deterministic (default: ollama)
  --ollama-url URL                 Ollama base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:11434)
  --upstream-url URL               Upstream /v1/systemone URL when --backend systemone
  --gguf PATH_OR_TAG               GGUF file path or Ollama model tag for llamacpp/managed
  --embedding-gguf PATH_OR_TAG     Optional dedicated GGUF path or Ollama tag for POST /v1/embeddings
                                   (when omitted, /v1/embeddings uses the active backend if supported)
  --embedding-model NAME           Optional served model ID for POST /v1/embeddings when --embedding-gguf is set
                                   (defaults to --model; advertised in GET /v1/models when distinct)
  --embedding-context-size N       Context window in tokens for --embedding-gguf (default: --context-size or 2048)
  --explicit-config                Disable all ambient env vars (CIDER_API_KEY, CIDER_LLAMA_*, GGML_BACKEND_PATH,
                                   OLLAMA_MODELS), require explicit absolute --gguf or --ollama-url/--upstream-url,
                                   require explicit --backend and --model, and disable silent GPU-to-CPU fallback
  --max-inflight N                 Maximum concurrent HTTP requests (default: 8)
  --request-t

result.stdout:
Usage: cider-server calibrate --dataset <path.jsonl> --output <cal.json> [options]

Fits per-question calibration parameters (temperature, optional label biases, Platt Noul bias)
from labeled JSONL examples, reports before/after calibration metrics and a suggested confidence
threshold, and writes a schema_version=1 calibration profile JSON file.

Required options:
  --dataset PATH                   Path to labeled JSONL dataset
  --output PATH                    Output path for versioned JSON calibration file (alias: -o)

Model and backend options:
  --backend KIND                   llamacpp | deterministic | managed | ollama (default: llamacpp if --gguf, else deterministic)
  --gguf PATH_OR_TAG               GGUF file path or Ollama model tag for llamacpp/managed
  --model NAME                     Model identifier recorded in calibration profile
  --ollama-url URL                 Ollama base URL when --backend ollama (default: http://127.0.0.1:11434)
  --model-hash SHA256              Optional 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex model hash (for backends without IModelIdentityProvider)
  --explicit-config                Require explicit --backend, --model, absolute paths, and disable ambient env vars

Calibration fitting options:
  --policy NAME                    v1 | state-first-v1 | tev1 | decider (default: v1)
  --layout NAME                    auto | chatml | llama3 | gemma | phi3 | mistral (default: auto)
  --noul-strategy NAME             binary | rating_1_to_9 (default: binary)
  --permutations N                 Option permutations during calibration (1..255; default: 1)
  --target-selective-accuracy R    Target selective accuracy in (0, 1] for suggested threshold (default: 0.90)
  --min-selective-coverage R       Minimum selective coverage in [0, 1] for suggested threshold (default: 0.0)
  --fit-label-biases               Also estimate zero-mean per-label prior biases for Choice/Score questions
  --no-noul-bias                   Fit 1-parameter temperature only for binary Noul (disable Platt bias)
  --min-temp
